fact: The report states the 2022 Population and Housing Census, Seychelles' sixth since independence and first digital census, was carried out in 2022 under the Census Act; no enumeration date is given in the captured text.
The NBS published Volume 2, the main census report with results at national, regional and district level, in March 2024, and refers to its compilation as the final report.
The bulletin states the NBS population estimates are benchmarked to the Population and Housing Census and that the 2010 and 2022 censuses are the anchor points for backcasting 2011-2021 estimates.
